# defectdojo_product (Resource)

Manages a DefectDojo product. DefectDojo 3.x shows products as *assets*.

~> **Deleting a product deletes its engagements**, with their tests and findings. The provider refuses to destroy a product that has engagements unless `force_destroy` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "defectdojo_product_type" "web" {
  name = "Web Applications"
}

data "defectdojo_user" "manager" {
  username = "jdoe"
}

resource "defectdojo_sla_configuration" "strict" {
  name     = "Internet-facing"
  critical = 3
  high     = 14
}

resource "defectdojo_product" "storefront" {
  name                 = "Storefront"
  description          = "The online shop"
  product_type_id      = defectdojo_product_type.web.id
  sla_configuration_id = defectdojo_sla_configuration.strict.id

  business_criticality = "high"
  platform             = "web"
  life_cycle           = "production"
  origin               = "internal"
  internet_accessible  = true

  product_manager_id = data.defectdojo_user.manager.id
  regulation_ids     = [1] # PCI DSS
  tags               = ["pci", "shop"]
}

# Without regulation_ids and tags, the provider leaves them as they are, so
# they can be managed elsewhere; authorized_users are managed here.
resource "defectdojo_product" "inventory" {
  name             = "Inventory"
  description      = "Stock management"
  product_type_id  = defectdojo_product_type.web.id
  authorized_users = [12, 15]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) The description of the product, at most 4000 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes. Trim heredocs with `chomp()` or `trimspace()`.
- `name` (String) The name of the product, at most 255 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes. Names are unique across all products, compared case-sensitively.
- `product_type_id` (Number) The ID of the product type of the product. Changing it moves the product to another product type.

### Optional

- `authorized_users` (Set of Number) The IDs of the users who may access the product, in addition to superusers, staff and the authorized users of its product type. When it is not set, the provider leaves the authorized users as they are, so they can be managed elsewhere. If it changes elsewhere between the plan and the apply of another change to the product, the apply fails with an inconsistent result; plan and apply again. An empty set removes them all.
- `business_criticality` (String) The business criticality of the product: one of `very high`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, `very low` and `none`.
- `disable_sla_breach_notifications` (Boolean) Whether to disable the notifications of SLA breaches of the product's findings. Defaults to `false`.
- `enable_full_risk_acceptance` (Boolean) Whether findings can be risk-accepted with a risk acceptance form. Defaults to `true`.
- `enable_product_tag_inheritance` (Boolean) Whether the product's engagements, tests and findings inherit its tags. DefectDojo also has a system-wide setting for this. Defaults to `false`.
- `enable_simple_risk_acceptance` (Boolean) Whether findings can be risk-accepted with a checkbox. Defaults to `false`.
- `external_audience` (Boolean) Whether the product is used by people outside the organization. Defaults to `false`.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Whether to destroy the product even when it has engagements, which DefectDojo then deletes too, with their tests and findings. Defaults to `false`.
- `internet_accessible` (Boolean) Whether the product is accessible from the internet. Defaults to `false`.
- `life_cycle` (String) The lifecycle of the product: the value of an entry of DefectDojo's product lifecycles, such as `construction`, `production` or `retirement`.
- `origin` (String) The origin of the product: the value of an entry of DefectDojo's product origins, such as `internal`, `third party library`, `purchased`, `contractor`, `open source` or `outsourced`.
- `platform` (String) The platform of the product: the value of an entry of DefectDojo's product platforms, such as `web`, `web service`, `desktop`, `mobile` or `iot`.
- `product_manager_id` (Number) The ID of the product's product manager, an active user.
- `regulation_ids` (Set of Number) The IDs of the regulations that apply to the product. When it is not set, the provider leaves the regulations as they are, so they can be managed elsewhere. If it changes elsewhere between the plan and the apply of another change to the product, the apply fails with an inconsistent result; plan and apply again. An empty set removes them all.
- `sla_configuration_id` (Number) The ID of the SLA configuration of the product, such as a `defectdojo_sla_configuration`. DefectDojo uses the Default SLA configuration (1) when it is not set. Changing it makes DefectDojo recalculate the SLA dates of the product's findings in the background; until that finishes, neither it nor the days of the new SLA configuration can be changed again. When it is not set, the provider leaves it as it is, so it can be managed elsewhere. If it changes elsewhere between the plan and the apply of another change to the product, the apply fails with an inconsistent result; plan and apply again.
- `tags` (Set of String) The tags of the product, each at most 255 characters, without spaces, commas or quotes. Tags are compared ignoring case: DefectDojo gives a tag the spelling of an existing product tag that matches it ignoring case, and the provider keeps the configured spelling (after an import, the first apply sets the configured spelling once). When it is not set, the provider leaves the tags as they are, so they can be managed elsewhere. If it changes elsewhere between the plan and the apply of another change to the product, the apply fails with an inconsistent result; plan and apply again. An empty set removes them all.
- `team_manager_id` (Number) The ID of the product's team manager, an active user.
- `technical_contact_id` (Number) The ID of the product's technical contact, an active user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of the product.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = defectdojo_product.example
  identity = {
    id = 7
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) ID of the product

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Products are imported by their numeric ID
terraform import defectdojo_product.example <id>
```
